Results.ReviewText:
Fantastic! I love my new grill!
Everyone should have one.

Results.ReviewText: Great grill. This is my 4th one but to be honest, my first new one. Over the past 40 years my other Weber charcoal grills were all purchased at yard sales or given to me when friends upgraded theirs and all held up great. If you like grilling with charcoal instead of gas, Weber is the only smart choice.
Results.Title: Charcoal is the only way to grill.

Results.ReviewText: I’ve own a 22” basic Weber for 19 years using it almost every day. My son has the 22” premium Weber and two years ago told me it was time to up grade to the premium. My basic Weber was still going strong with a couple of replacement parts. I finally decided it was time to replace my dependable Weber and bought the 22” premium. Love the contained ash catcher and the thermometer in the lid (I added one to my basic Weber, but this is classy looking). The only complaint I have with the new Weber is the lid is a little sloppy. After the first use, the charcoal burnt down to ashes after shutting it down. I was very disappointed as one of the major benefits of the Weber is the conserving of charcoal. It has been getting better after a month of use, but when using wood chips, smoke billows out between the bowl and lid. I told my son about it and he said he had the same problem when his was new. He said you can buy a seal like on a oven door but they deteriorate in a few years. When I went to the website, and asked about this issue, I found that the problem would correct as residue builds up between the lid and bowl. Other than that, I am looking forward to another 20 years of grilling on my new Weber.
Results.Title: Upgrading to the 22” Premium Weber

Results.ReviewText: Exactly what we wanted, good charcoal grill flavor.  Easy to assemble.  Just wish it was a bit taller and the legs were thicker
Results.Title: Perfect, just like old times!

Results.ReviewText: This is our 2nd Weber. We got one about 10 years ago and have loved it. We also love this new 22 in. Kettle grill. We got it in green. Customer service was great! The grill came missing a leg and the customer service representative overnighted a new leg kit. Overall, we have had a great experience with Weber so far! :) The new colors are fun too!
Results.Title: 22 in. Weber Kettle Grill

Results.ReviewText: It's so well made.  I have other knock offs and they don't even come close to this grill.  The bronze color is special!  Love this grill!
Results.Title: You get Quality with a Webber!

Results.ReviewText: Add a couple accessories and you have the perfect grill and smoker.

Results.ReviewText:
I’m a loyal Weber grill owner for 30+ years starting with a Smokey Joe as an apartment dweller and then multiple 22 inch original kettles.  I recently considered purchasing a high priced kamado grill but decided to continue to refine my skills with the Weber kettle.  The premium model proved to be more than worthy of the higher price with the heat shield, thermometer, and improved ash catcher cooking grate.

All in all you can’t beat the quality.   It lives outside  and is used year round here in the Northeast and will survive for years.
Results.Title: Highly satisfied long time customer

Results.ReviewText: This grill is fantastic. Clean up is a breeze and heat retention is phenomenal. With all the accessories I bought it’s fantastic.

Results.ReviewText:
Two easily fixable negatives with this unit. Which makes what would otherwise be the right price instead, overpriced. 
1. The handle is the wrong way in comparison to the hook that is inside the lid. That ergonomics so obvious like this haven’t been brought to attention, on a unit that has been in production for so long is mind boggling. You almost need to grab the hot lid with your other hand due to the lack of balance. Easy fix by moving the inside hook a 1/4 circle. 
2. The bottom grate; the one that is designed for the coals is NOT rust free and began to rust Immediately.
Results.Title: A couple of upgrades needed.

Results.ReviewText: I haven’t had much experience grilling before I bought the Original Kettle Premium Charcoal Grill 22" and I have to say it was worth the purchase. After reading the reviews and watching a couple of instruction videos on YouTube I’ve been grilling every weekend since I’ve gotten this grill. It is a great starter grill which has made making food with it an experience I look forward to every time I start it up.

Results.ReviewText: After years of buying cheap grills year after year, I finally broke down and bought a Weber. It's unbelievable what a difference it makes in the results of your food by using a good grill. Very high quality and workmanship. The grill was very easy to assemble, and I love the copper color. Do yourself a favor and get a Weber kettle. You won't regret it.

Results.ReviewText: I'm a propane gal and my husband is a charcoal guy. He's making great food out there. Not a total convert yet but he's slowly nudging me that direction with each great meal.
Results.Title: Grills Great Food

Results.ReviewText: I love the versatility it offers! It’s like having 3 in one!
Results.Title: Can’t go wrong!

Results.ReviewText: I recently bought a new Weber grill. My fourth Weber in 50 years of real grilling and cooking. This particular grill I’m shipping to England and my new condo where I’ll cook in the common space each week to the gastronomic delight of the other retired residents. I’ll live in Somerset, England for six months then return th Greensboro, NC and my faithful 15 year old Weber grill. If I’m in England for Christmas I’ll cook a traditional goose on my grill. It’ll take about two hours and the smell from the grill will be intoxicating. Of course a glass of sherry will bring celebration to the cooking process. If I’m back in Greensboro I’ll cook a turkey on my trusty grill. That will also take about two hours or thre bourbons.
Results.Title: UK Cooking with USA Weber grill

Results.ReviewText: Easy to use the first time. Lid on cooks fast. Lid off grills a single side. Versatile for meats, veggies or using a cast iron skillet. Large enough grill surface area for 8 hungry mouths. Quick clean up. I've grilled with gas and gas fired briquets with all the bells and whistles. The Kettle's simplicity wins.
Results.Title: Simpler grilling with the Kettle

Results.ReviewText: Great grill, nice to have charcoal option. Using many of Michael Symon grilling recipes and food is coming out fabulous. Gas is convenient but the flavor is in the charcoal!
Results.Title: Weber

Results.ReviewText:
It is what it is! The Weber kettle is a nicely built unit for the money. I’ve only had mine for a month or so but have used it a dozen times or so on various meats. The real joy actually, is getting to know your kettle, and learn how to cook, and control various meats. I love my Weber kettle, and look forward to enjoying learning, and, refining my  cooking techniques.
Thanks Weber!

Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: I love my new grill. Use it at least 3 times a week

Results.ReviewText: I love bbq on a Weber. But it’s really a entry level model that doesn’t retain heat well. So great smoking flavor on anything that’s under 45-60 minutes. If you’re cooking longer, feel free to keep feeding the beast to  keep your temperature consistent. This bbq is great for the charcoal industry but is not suited for bbq wood. Base grill is almost bent out of shape after less than ten uses.
Results.Title: Grills a great steak for 32 years. Entry level.

Results.ReviewText: I have tested a couple of the new high end smokers and before I invested my money, I bought this charcoal grill. I feel it holds the desired temperature for smoking ribs and briskets with a little attention. Also great for burgers & steaks!
Results.Title: Great for the beginners!

Results.ReviewText: Amazing grill; direct, indirect, hot and fast, slow and sear, it does it all.
Results.Title: Amazing grill!

Results.ReviewText: Solid grill, plenty of options. Easy to clean, easy to cook
Results.Title: 22" Kettle BBQ Grill

Results.ReviewText: Assembly was easy. Have thoroughly enjoyed grilling. Love have the app and all its directions on grilling different meats. Hopefully this grill will last 25 years like our last Weber did. Happy Grilling!!!
Results.Title: So happy!!

Results.ReviewText: I grew up with my dad grilling on one of these. Having never owned a grill I immediately knew I wanted the Weber kettle. This little grill is great! So versatile and it looks nice too. This is a very high quality, well made grill. I would recommend getting the cover. All In all I spent less than 200 bucks. Can’t beat it! If you’re looking for a grill. Stop looking. You found it.
Results.Title: I love my Weber!

Results.ReviewText: The lid hook stinks..it’s hard to find when you’re holding a hot lid.  The cleaning system only works ok..the fingers don’t sit flush to the bottom so ash gets under them..and the slots are small so they plug up..I recommend including a brush with the grill to aid in the cleaning process.
Results.Title: Kind hook stinks cleaning system is only ok.

Results.ReviewText: I really like the grill.  I think the hook to hang the cover on the side could be a bit longer.  Also taking off the ash catcher requires a good bit of force to squeeze the handle and retract the pins.
Results.Title: Grill Review

Results.ReviewText: Not much i need to say about the weber. It is THEE standard for charcoal grills. Holds up well, great accessories and looks sharp. I recently had a chance to deal with their support/warranty department as well and was super satisfied. Simply the best out there.
Results.Title: The standard for charcoal grills

Results.ReviewText: We have enjoyed this type of Weber charcoal grill since 1980. The only reason we have to replace is deterioration. I feel this one has some wonderful improvements like the thermostat, the grate that opens on two sides and the ash catcher is not just a flat metal bowl. I love the different ways to grill with it. Our kids also have Weber grills now. Great product that lasts!
Results.Title: Great product that lasts!

Results.ReviewText: I love my new grill. It’s easy to use, easy to keep clean, and it’s a beautiful classic design.
Results.Title: Easy and Beautiful!

14407001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14407001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
